plan: To preserve capital, we'll cut all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce overall market exposure.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to favor income and broad market stability.
We'll add a new position in DDOG at 5% as a top-quality name from the scanner.
This plan aims for a large cash buffer and tight stops for low drawdown.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential. The focus is on stability and income.

plan: We'll trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce overall leverage.
SPY will be trimmed to 23% to meet concentration limits.
QQQI will be increased to 31% to balance growth with income.
CRWD will be added to 15% to lean into a quality tech name that is working.
A new position in SMCI will be initiated at 5% from the scanner's strong setups.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and a small amount of leverage. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

plan: SPY will be trimmed to 25% to meet concentration limits.
We'll add to SOXL (10%), MUU (6%), and METU (6%) to lean into leveraged ETFs.
CRWD will be increased to 15% to concentrate in a high-scoring tech name.
A new position in SMCI will be initiated at 8% from the scanner's strong setups.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of higher potential drawdowns, daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs, and the risk of rapid losses if stops are hit.

plan: To prioritize income, we'll sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero.
High-beta single names like CRWD and SNOW will also be sold to near zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce growth focus.
QQQI will be significantly increased to 60% to maximize monthly distributions.
This plan aims for low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable monthly distributions from income ETFs. Remember, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
